summons: Decoy (Harmless Contraption top, level 1): HP 10 [square], Move 3 [square], Attack -, Range - (no attack); no traits printed
Battle Bot (Dangerous Contraption top, level 4): HP 7 [square], Move 3 [square], Attack 3 [square], Range - (melee); no traits printed
Kill Bot (Murderous Contraption top, level 7): HP 8 [square], Move 4 [square], Attack 3 [square], Range - (melee), attack area: grey hex + 2 red hexes in a diagonal line up-right; no traits printed
mechanics: Summons: Decoy (no attack), Battle Bot, Kill Bot (area attack printed in its stat block) (Harmless Contraption, Dangerous Contraption, Murderous Contraption tops; all persistent then lost, XP 3)

Placed tokens with persistent effects: +1 Attack for you and allies within range 1 (Enhancement Field top); two tokens treated as adjacent for moves (Teleportation Pad top); end-of-turn damage 2 to every ally and enemy within range 1 (Pernicious Fogger top); delayed bomb: at the end of your next turn pull all enemies within range 2 toward it, damage 5 on the token hex, damage 1 adjacent, then discard (Gravity Bomb top)

Traps created by abilities, with damage + conditions, placed adjacent or within range 2: Gas Canister top (4, Muddle), Volatile Concoction bottom (2, Poison), Proximity Mine bottom (2, Immobilize, range 2), Cryonic Snare top (4, Wound + Stun, range 2)

Use-slot persistent cards: +1 Target on next four single-target heals (Potent Potables bottom, 4 slots); end-of-turn Heal 1 range 5 + Strengthen/Bless/Ward/Safeguard for 5 turns (Invigorating Aerosol bottom); end-of-turn Attack 2 range 5 Pierce 1 twice for 4 turns (Auto Turret top); all lost after the last slot
XP per enemy targeted (Disorienting Flash top, Ink Bomb top, Net Shooter top, Noxious Vials bottom); XP per enemy killed (Disintegration Beam top)
Execute: kill all enemies in an area with current hit points <= 5 (Disintegration Beam top)

Recover cards for allies: all discarded cards (Reinvigorating Elixir bottom), one level 1 card from discard (Volatile Concoction top), one lost card (Stamina Booster bottom), one card from an adjacent ally's lost pile (Chimeric Formula bottom); the last two carry the card-stack-with-red-X ('permanently lost') icon

Abilities granted to allies: Shield 1 to self and adjacent allies (Flamethrower bottom), Shield 1 to one adjacent ally (Dangerous Contraption bottom), Retaliate 2 to one adjacent ally (Cryonic Snare bottom), an ally suffers damage 2 then performs Move 2 + Attack 6 (Harsh Stimulants top), the healed ally immediately plays up to two cards (Chimeric Formula top)
Control an enemy: it attacks all adjacent enemies with its attack +2, then gains Stun (Harsh Stimulants bottom)
Conditions applied to adjacent-to-target enemies: Muddle (Proximity Mine top)
Round attack buff for you and adjacent allies (Enhancement Field bottom)

Stand-alone condition abilities (no attack): Stun (Stun Shot top, Disorienting Flash top with Target 3), Immobilize (Net Shooter bottom), Strengthen (Volatile Concoction top, Pernicious Fogger bottom), Ward and Poison (Auto Turret bottom)
Conditions used: Muddle, Immobilize, Stun, Wound, Poison, Disarm, Strengthen, Bless, Ward, Safeguard (Safeguard is not a Frosthaven condition: Invigorating Aerosol bottom)
unclear: Invigorating Aerosol bottom: the image clearly prints Heal 1 (zoomed); GHS says Heal 2 and Xipe Heal 3. I kept 1. Worth a check against another printing or errata

Card-stack-with-red-X corner icon (Stamina Booster, Chimeric Formula bottoms): I wrote it as 'permanently lost' after Xipe's Discard name; check the 2e rulebook for its exact name and rule. GHS also flags Reinvigorating Elixir's bottom with it (bottomLoss), but that card doesn't print the icon
Harsh Stimulants bottom: 'all adjacent enemies' for a controlled enemy: whose enemies (the monster's own allies, or your enemies) is a rules question, not a reading one
Pernicious Fogger top: whether 'all allies' includes you (the Tinkerer) and your summons is a rules question
Enhancement Field bottom: whether 'adjacent allies' are fixed when the card is played or follow adjacency through the round (Xipe uses a round aura) is a rules question
Green heart-in-dashed-ring icon on Invigorating Aerosol read as Safeguard, following GHS (the pink shield is Ward, confirmed by Auto Turret; yellow is Bless, confirmed by Chimeric Formula)
